text: Backend read-only project mode: refuse every mutation and report it
description: A project opened read-only must reject all writes at one choke point, with a clear 'read-only' error, and expose its read-only state to the frontend (e.g. in project meta/state). Generalize the existing guard that already refuses writes to projects from a newer Aimparency version (assertWritableBowman), so both cases share one mechanism and one message.

status.comment:
Backend read-only mode via runtime/read-only marker + project.getAccess; awaiting acceptance.

shared/bowman-migration: READ_ONLY_MARKER (.bowman/runtime/read-only, gitignored, machine-local), ReadOnlyProjectError, bowmanWriteBlocker(path) -> Error|null; assertWritableBowman (already on every idea/phase/meta write, delete, history restore) now refuses both read-only and newer-data-model projects. project.getAccess -> { writable, reason } for the UI (f32a74fd). phase.setCursor skips persistence when not writable (navigation keeps working). Aimparency-owned upkeep (caches, embeddings, loops runtime, migrations of the clone) is intentionally still allowed.

Evidence: read-only-project.test.ts: 10 mutation kinds (create floating/sub, update, delete, disconnect, removeFromPhase, addReflection, phase create/update, updateMeta) all reject with the read-only message; ideas/phases/meta.json byte-identical afterwards; list queries work; setCursor returns success:false; getAccess flips from writable to the reason. pnpm check 25/25. MCP and loop-worker writes go through the backend, so they are covered by the same guard.
